question: Does the preserved fixed policy actually play Night Sight, receive a later turn-start draw with its persistent status, and subsequently play Phantom in that turn often enough to justify qualifying this unmeasured source operator?
coverage: Every preserved assigned outcome and command trace in all four worlds and all completed vows. No successful-only sample, new seeds, controller or game execution.
distinction: The closed value studies suppressed only direct Preparation/Surge draw. Night Sight's persistent turn-start draw remained background. This accounting does not reopen their hypotheses, change their primary metrics, retune their candidates, or create an extra strategy slot.
source_binding: Read the actual archived card definitions, EventTypes and native start-turn/draw functions. Verify the Night Sight status contribution and every consumed file against the preserved source/capture manifests.
observable: A successful Night Sight status application in the same fight, followed by a later turn marker with positive remaining status and at least one actual turn-start draw, followed by a legal Phantom play during that turn. Same-turn plays, empty draw packets and previous-fight status do not qualify.
interpretation: This is an upper bound on source-related opportunities, not attribution of particular extra cards: baseline draw, hand cap, empty piles and omens can remove marginal Night Sight draw. Neither temporal co-occurrence nor a win establishes a causal benefit.

screen.pass: Both fixed payoff-on worlds satisfy these necessary opportunity counts. Only missing persistent-source operator qualification becomes a justified next action, not population or package admission.
screen.fail: This fixed policy/capture cannot supply the required opportunity support. Do not launch a new Night Sight population cohort, tune the closed nomination or equate this with universal Hand nonviability.
screen.invalid: Missing identities, unknown source semantics or inconsistent trace coverage produce INCONCLUSIVE with actual diagnostics, never fabricated zero support.

preservation: Commit code and protocol; preserve all derived records and source/coverage/input manifests; cold-read committed bytes and reconstruct the same readout without the engine. Keep every previous terminal immutable.
